body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}\) and \(0<\delta\le\delta_0\), \[c_{\mathrm{mod}}\delta^{\kappa}\le\omega_P(\delta;z_0)\le C\delta^{\kappa}.\] The upper inequality follows from Holder smoothness and covariance ellipticity. The lower inequality is exactly the disclosed one-direction condition \texttt{ass:attainable-local-modulus} and is not derived from the other panel conditions.
body.justification: The lemma pairs the derived Holder upper bound with the explicitly maintained one-direction lower condition needed for matching donor-location converses.
body.gap: Donoho (1994) fixes a Gaussian operator and convex class; this modulus uses an unknown full stacked donor covariance and avoids a multidirectional co-Holder condition that a scalar regression cannot satisfy.
body.consumer: The event-study estimator can calibrate one covariance-aware proxy-bias radius while the lower bound remains legal on nondegenerate multivariate path neighborhoods.
